title: You Too
lyrics_plain:
You never wanted her!
You never needed her!
You never were with her!
You never understood her!
I do, I could, I would, I should!
Have you seen her? Are you through?
Have you freed her? Was it good
for me too?
You never wanted her!
You never needed her!
You never were with her!
You never understood her!
I do, I could, I would, I should!
It's my baby!
That is true!
What you doing with her too?
She's my love!
And I do!
And I could!
And I would!
And I should!
Love her, too!
Hey, have you seen my baby?
was she being good to you?
Now, that it's over will you
be there too forever?
I do, I could, I would, I should!
It's my baby, think it over!
Leave her now, she's my lover!
Yes, it's true!
You don't love her!
You don't need her!
You never wanted her!
You always knew it was true!
I did! I knew! It's true! You too!
It's my baby, think it over!
Leave her now, she's my lover!
Yes, it's true!
It's you too?
It's me too?
It's you too?
It's us too?
Love her, too!
